## Overview
A longitudinal study examining microbiome, virome, phage–host, and mobile-genetic-element dynamics following spinal cord injury (SCI), an area where gut microbial disruption is thought to influence recovery and health outcomes.

## Scientific or practical problem
Spinal cord injury is associated with disruption of the gut microbiome, but how virome and phage–host dynamics change over time, and how mobile genetic elements move through the community post-injury, is not well characterized.

## My role
**Bioinformatics/statistical analysis support** for longitudinal microbiome and virome profiling.

## Dataset or data type
Longitudinal microbiome/virome sequencing samples from an SCI cohort or model system. *(Specific cohort details withheld pending publication.)*

## Methods and technologies
- Longitudinal microbiome and virome profiling
- Phage–host linkage prediction
- Mobile genetic element detection
- Time-series statistical analysis
